description: This pie chart visually represents the four core dimensions of the “Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge” benchmark for LLMs, as presented in the paper. The chart is divided into four equal quadrants, each representing one dimension: “Complexity” (gold, with a ladder icon), “Instance” (blue-gray, with a shield and checkmark icon), “Coverage” (green, with a globe and gear icon), and “Oversight” (maroon, with a clipboard and checkmark icon). Each quadrant is labeled with its respective dimension and is also associated with a descriptive term in a surrounding box: “Uncrushable” for Complexity, “Unhackable” for Instance, “General” for Coverage, and “Auto-verifiable” for Oversight. The chart is designed to show that these four dimensions are equally weighted or fundamental components of the benchmark, as each occupies exactly one-quarter of the pie. There is no legend, no percentage labels within the slices, and no visual emphasis (like exploded slices) on any particular segment. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-left quadrant.
